headline: Fort Lauderdale United: what changes in 2027?
caption:
Broward has another men’s pro team to get to know. Fort Lauderdale United is set to join USL League One in spring 2027, at Amerant Bank Field in Davie.

The women already play there. A women’s match is a way to get to know the club and the ground before the men’s first season.

Who would you bring along?

Club announcement: https://www.ftlutd.com/news/2026/09/30/fort-lauderdale-united-usl-league-one/
#BrowardSoccer #FortLauderdale #USLLeagueOne
altText: Cancha explains Fort Lauderdale United’s planned spring 2027 men’s USL League One debut. Real women’s club footage runs behind the graphics; it does not show the new men’s team.
